caseNameFull: A. G. Triplett v. Percival D. Lowell
attorneys: Mr. Samuel E. Darby, Jr., for petitioners., Messrs. C. V. Edwards and John B. Brady for respondent.

opinions.text: It is ordered that the petition for rehearing in this case be, and it hereby is, granted. The order heretofore entered on October 14, 1935, [post, p. 621] denying the petition for writ of certiorari in this case is vacated, and it is ordered that the petition for writ of certiorari be, and the same hereby is, granted.
